prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A simple crown-like form — three rounded points over a horizontal band,
reduced to essential silhouette.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor archival plate rendering a simplified crown silhouette centered on aged parchment, ember orange against deep slate ink shadow with warm vellum cream ground.

subjects.description: Three rounded points rising from a solid horizontal band, bold reduced silhouette, thick clean linework, high-contrast archival stamp quality.
Aged parchment surface, faint foxing at edges, muted warm vellum texture beneath the icon form.
